lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five parallel horizontal rows, extending from the posterior margin of the fifth gill slit towards the caudal peduncle, with highest concentration in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to create a grid-like pattern, particularly prominent between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing surface to shadow-based low-intensity on the ventral-facing surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots scattered across the medial and posterior portions of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated organic silhouette is attached to the upper flank immediately ventral to the origin of the first dorsal fin.
